text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 zone. Error spike started ~02:02 UTC. Likely tokenizer/preproc CPU/memory pressure.

samir: seeing same in dashboards — tokenization CPU percent climbs to 98% and kube shows OOMKilled on tokenizer-preproc pods. Noticed multiple pods died on node ip-10-1-4-22.

kevin: logs from pod tokenizer-preproc-77f8:
```
2026-03-15T02:03:10Z ERROR preproc: buffer allocation failure: requested 1.2GB, available 900MB
killed by signal 9 (OOMKilled)
```

maria: dmesg on node -> 'Out of memory: Kill process 12345 (tokenizer) score 987 or sacrifice child'. Node memory saturated by user-space buffers.

samir: impact: approx 8% error rate for hosted customers hitting generation endpoints (mainly long-prompts). Page sent to eng-oncall and infra oncall.

julie_ops: duplicate alert: majority of 5xx from model gpt-open-small and new v2 tokenization path. Recent rollout 1958b7 increased parallel token parsing to 12.

eng-runtime: can we roll back that deploy? It's a canary but looks like some traffic hit canary pods in prod.

kevin: rolling back canary now. Command:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/tokenizer-preproc -n prod --to-revision=1958b6
```

support-bot: customer-impact-note: some customers report timeouts (~30s). Support triage started; estimating 15 min to mitigate.

samir: immediate mitigations we applied:
- cordoned node ip-10-1-4-22 and drained tokenizer pods off it
- scaled tokenizer-preproc replicas from 6 -> 12 to spread load
- reduced environment var TOKENIZER_MAX_PARALLEL from 12 -> 4 in the deployment (hotpatch)

kevin: applied hotpatch:
```
kubectl set env deployment/tokenizer-preproc TOKENIZER_MAX_PARALLEL=4 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/tokenizer-preproc -n prod
```

maria: also added k8s resource limits to preproc (memory 1.5Gi -> 1Gi) to prevent unbounded allocation. Watch for memory pressure.

eng-runtime: added a temporary gateway rate limit for generative routes to 50rps/model to reduce bursty fanout. Config pushed to envoy via config service.

samir: after these steps 5xx dropped from 8% -> 1.2% in 6 minutes. Some pods still show OOMKilled but new pods come up healthy. :thumbsup:

julie_ops: note: need follow-up - revert the aggressive parallelism change and add a controlled rollout plan. Create RCA ticket and schedule postmortem.

support-bot: created ticket: INC-3958 with initial customer impact summary and list of affected customers. Link: https://tickets.example/INC-3958

kevin: also found one node with kernel oom_reaper thrashing — will reprovision node and add node-level oom_score_adj for tokenizer containers to prefer killing tokenizer rather than kubelet. Planning to cordon and terminate node.

eng-runtime: follow-up actions (owners):
- eng-runtime / kevin: complete rollback of tokenization concurrency change + add safety feature flag (ETA 2d)
- infra / maria: increase node group cpu headroom and add CPUPressure alerts (ETA 1d)
- oncall / samir: tune TOKENIZER_MAX_PARALLEL default to 4 and add e2e test for long prompt memory usage (ETA 3d)
- support / julie_ops: customer comms draft (ETA 2h)

samir: handing off to morning oncall: @kevin you're primary for next 6h. I'll document the state and remain reachable.

kevin: ack, taking over. Will post progress updates here. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident severity: sev2 -> reduced to sev3 after mitigation. Update on page: https://incidents.example/1959009999

maria: last note — preserved logs & core dumps stored in s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1959009999/ for RCA. Please don't delete.

kevin: closing loop: current state stable, continue to monitor for 2h, if >1% errors reopen. Thanks all for quick response. :clap:
